column1: A WSI of ILC at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of a diffuse infiltrative pattern with little desmoplastic response, often appearing as target-like lesions (bullseye lesion) or concentric growth, and being less well-defined or palpable.

A WSI of IDC at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of irregularly shaped masses, stellate or spiculated borders due to stromal invasion, desmoplastic reaction in the surrounding tissue, and a tendency to form solid sheets or large nests.

A WSI of ILC at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of small, uniform cells, a single-file or linear pattern of infiltration, lack of cohesion due to E-cadherin loss, round or indented nuclei, and characteristic intracytoplasmic vacuoles (signet ring cells are rare but possible).

A WSI of IDC at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of pleomorphic cells, large nuclei with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli, tubule/gland formation (variable), abundant mitotic figures, and intraductal component.
